body:
GREG, 2026-11-14 about 06:17Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1155, message 64c7a7b9). Verbatim: „Dl560 powien miec zrobione git pull przed cargo run --release.”
Rule: whoever starts the TermAl host on DL560 first runs `git pull` in that checkout, then `cargo run --release`. The host must not be restarted only to apply this rule.
Observation at the time: origin/master of TermAl was 491dd015, and Fable2 (#7883) attested DL560 running 491dd015 after the 06:10Z restart, so that start matched current master.
Owner of the DL560 host start procedure: TermAl (Termal::Fable2). It was forwarded there.
